description: This file defines the OpenAiNativeHandler class, which manages interactions with OpenAI's Responses API, including streaming and non-streaming message creation, handling various event types, and managing request lifecycle and error handling.

classes.name: OpenAiNativeHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with OpenAI's Responses API, including streaming responses, managing request state, and processing various event types.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream using the Responses API, formatting conversation history and handling streaming events.

methods.name: handleResponsesApiMessage
methods.description: Handles the process of sending a message request to the Responses API and managing the streaming response.

methods.name: buildRequestBody
methods.description: Constructs the request payload for the Responses API, ensuring schema compliance and including relevant parameters.

methods.name: executeRequest
methods.description: Executes the API request, manages abort signals, and falls back to SSE if SDK streaming fails.

methods.name: formatFullConversation
methods.description: Formats the conversation history into the structure expected by the Responses API.

methods.name: makeResponsesApiRequest
methods.description: Performs a raw fetch request to the Responses API endpoint, handling errors and streaming the response.

methods.name: handleStreamResponse
methods.description: Processes the streaming response from the Responses API, parsing SSE data and yielding structured output chunks.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes individual event objects from the Responses API stream, handling different event types and extracting content.

methods.name: getReasoningEffort
methods.description: Determines the reasoning effort level based on options and model defaults.

methods.name: getPromptCacheRetention
methods.description: Returns the prompt cache retention policy based on model info.

methods.name: applyServiceTierPricing
methods.description: Overrides model pricing details based on the selected service tier.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model configuration, including ID, info, and parameters.

methods.name: getEncryptedContent
methods.description: Extracts encrypted reasoning content and ID from the last response output for stateless API continuity.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Performs a non-streaming prompt completion via the Responses API.
